run_GenericModel_forward: run the GenericModel forward pass to render images from RGB inputs, cameras, and foreground masks
create_GenericModel: create a GenericModel instance with configurable ray sampler, renderer, and implicit function components
render_GenericModel_render: render images by raymarching through sampled rays using the configured renderer and implicit functions
construct_GenericModel_construct_implici: construct implicit function wrappers for NeRF, IDr, or SRN-based scene representations with view pooling support
visualize_GenericModel_visualize: visualize model predictions including rendered images, depths, and masks using a Visdom server
